methodology.inference: Descriptive associations, not causal effects. No IID clip-level p-values or confidence intervals.
methodology.adjusted_ranks: Pearson correlation of pooled average ranks after subtracting each speaker/session's mean rank.
methodology.effect_size: Eta squared is observed variance accounted for by group means. Partial R2 adds language to speaker fixed effects.
methodology.concentration: Inverse sum of squared group word shares; concentration measure, not an effective independent sample size.
methodology.confounding: Speaker is nested in conversation; their independent effects are not identifiable here.
methodology.vocabulary: OOV and Jensen-Shannon divergence are reference-text properties; no model inference or WER was measured.
methodology.ratios: Word rate divides word count by duration; correlations involving these are partly mathematical.
methodology.training_rows: 6638 positive timestamp rows, including five measured to available audio bounds; defect flags remain in the primary audit.
methodology.feature_limits: Clip-averaged descriptors; no native-listener validation, word alignment, language-ID, source device, or speaker embedding model.

duration_standardized_shift.limitation: Coarse post-stratification on duration bins with shared support; not causal adjustment.
